native_path.candidate_generation: The planner consumes visual and ego-status inputs and proposes vocabulary trajectories plus offsets. In stage2 evaluation the top-k candidates enter TrajWorldRefiner.
native_path.consumer: worlddrive_agent.py:425 calls trajrefiner; worlddrive_refiner.py:113-125 predicts a future-scene hidden representation, reads it with the candidate token, computes a score and selects an actual trajectory.
native_path.important_correction: Distillation does not imply absence of an inference-time forecast consumer. The distilled hidden future is consumed; the separate video generator is not required for this scoring path.
native_path.visual_output_boundary: The 16-dimensional visual projection is computed after the score and selection. Replacing only this returned visual output would not alter the already-computed native score. A hidden-latent intervention would be a different operation.
native_path.candidate_axis: The refiner folds candidate count into batch size before both decoders. Its fixed-candidate future stage has no cross-candidate attention; generator interactions upstream are distinct.

goal_contract.status_inputs: Driving command, velocity and acceleration enter the upstream planner.
goal_contract.future_inputs: Fixed candidate coordinates/embeddings and fixed visual tokens enter the refiner. There is no separate Goal/route argument at this point.
goal_contract.decision: Changing the original route normally changes candidate generation and intended utility. It is not a qualified branch-only Goal intervention under a fixed-action physical forecast contract.
goal_contract.limits: This is a pinned-source finding, not a claim that the entire architecture is safe or that arbitrary hidden-latent modifications are meaningful attacks.

required_inputs: Matched stage2 checkpoint and trajectory vocabulary
Matched NAVSIM scene features, or camera inputs plus CogVideoX VAE encoding
Matching independent PDM metric cache for actual simulated utility
resources.setup_caveat: The published constructor also initializes a world-model object and a hardcoded training metric-cache path for training_mode=wm; the evaluation script uses an author-local cache. No claim that these are ready locally.

decision: Retain native forecast-consumer source evidence; do not begin setup merely because a checkpoint exists. No new fixed-action Goal security experiment is qualified.
revision_kind: Git tree object ID from the tree API; a corresponding commit ID was not separately resolved.
